# JobCtrl v0.4.4

JobCtrl v0.4.4 fixes unlimited-budget admission, re-tailoring after score changes, and confusing workflow timelines. The workspace remains on schema 15.

## Fixes and improvements

- A daily USD budget of `0` and a current-lane token limit of `0` allow new model calls even when an older usage receipt is unresolved. Unknown usage remains visible as incomplete accounting; receipts are preserved. A positive global budget or current-lane token limit still requires resolved accounting.
- Explicit **Re-tailor** can run with a stale, failed, or canceled scoring state. It uses the latest saved profile and settings without implicitly re-scoring the job. Automatic preparation retains its scoring readiness and fit thresholds.
- Manually correcting a score carries the existing requirement report and evidence items to the new score version atomically. Their original profile and employer-analysis provenance is retained. Re-tailoring repairs older missing correction bindings only when the recorded scoring determination identifies the source evidence.
- Workflow timelines group events by recorded execution, order events by time, and show one start notification per identified attempt. Failure details belong to the current attempt. Older attempts and unidentified legacy history remain inspectable.
- The job action is labeled **Re-tailor**, and its confirmation explicitly says that the latest profile and settings will be used. Accepted materials stay available until a replacement is approved, including when a refresh fails.

## Update and recovery

Run `jobctrl update` to acquire the signed release. Supported schema-15 installations retain profiles, resumes, settings, search configuration and Temporal history. This patch adds no database schema transition. Reload an already-open browser tab after updating.

Setting only the global budget to zero does not disable a positive lane limit. Configure both limits as zero when unlimited admission is intended for that lane. Incomplete accounting remains distinct from budget admission: this release does not add automatic reconciliation for an uncertain aggregate-ledger commit. Preserve pending usage receipts; do not delete them to clear a warning. Native rollback and interrupted-update recovery continue to refuse unresolved or unverifiable receipt state.

Explicit rollback restores the paired snapshot for the selected release; later workspace changes are not carried backward. Rollback to a runtime that cannot read schema 15 remains unavailable. The existing v0.3.1 upgrade restriction also remains: its legacy ownership records do not establish a verified shutdown. Preserve that installation and follow the [update and recovery guide](https://jobctrl.dev/user/getting-started#update-roll-back-or-remove-jobctrl).

## Requirements

The signed installer and Homebrew package support Apple-silicon macOS 15 or later and include their own Python runtime. Model-backed work requires a configured, authenticated provider. Review generated materials before use; this release does not submit applications.

**Full changelog:** [v0.4.3...v0.4.4](https://github.com/ebarti/JobCtrl/compare/v0.4.3...v0.4.4)
